idea: Why to-do lists make you less productive
text:
What if writing every task makes you slower? [pause] I see it all the time. My mind gets tangled in the list. [look at camera] Here's the thing: it creates noise instead of clarity.

First, you write everything down. [gesture] Then you check each box. [pause] That act signals completion. But the brain doesn’t fully rest. It stays on alert. [look at camera] Third, you compare unfinished items. [emphasize] That builds tension. [smooth transition] The list becomes a weight.

The real gain comes from stillness. [quiet tone] You don’t need more checks. Just let the moment breathe. [pause] Nothing to do.
title: Why to-do lists hurt your focus
